subject: Sync: demo logistics + MSA redline owners (compact review)
body:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liz Barton <liz.barton@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sync: demo logistics + MSA redline owners (compact review)
Attachments: demo-runbook.xlsx (34 KB); MSA_redlines_v3.pdf (120 KB)

Hi Liz / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To make the next phase efficient, we'd like to run a compact, gated session that pairs the contractual owners (legal/procurement) with a tight demo for the feature set the MSA references. Goal: 1) resolve high-priority redlines that block signature, 2) show the exact behavior that motivated the clauses so legal and procurement have context.

Proposal (compact cadence):
- 30-minute legal + procurement redline review (owners only) — go line-by-line on the flagged clauses in MSA_redlines_v3.pdf
- 30-minute product demo + Q&A (product/PMs + legal on call optional) — focused on data flows and retention settings called out in the contract

Why this split? We want the subject-matter owners to clear gating items quickly and then have product show the functional side so any last-minute technical asks are resolved before a signature pass. If you prefer one contiguous 60-minute meeting, we can do that, but splitting tends to reduce friction.

Availability windows (Pacific):
- Tue Nov 2: 09:30–11:00 or 14:00–16:00 PT
- Wed Nov 3: 09:00–11:30 PT (preferred for our legal team)
- Thu Nov 4: 12:30–15:00 PT

Pre-reads attached: demo-runbook.xlsx (agenda + deck links) and our consolidated redlines (MSA_redlines_v3.pdf). Please confirm: 1) final attendees (who will own the redline walk), 2) whether you want exchange via DocuSign preview before the call, and 3) preferred slot.

If helpful I can send a one-page agenda and a short list of live toggles we'll demo.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0171

-----Original Message-----
From: Liz Barton <liz.barton@novushealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Sync: demo logistics + MSA redline owners (compact review)

Thanks, Sofia — this framing is helpful. Procurement and legal want to see the redlines first, then the demo. My preference is to have a short legal-only pass to clear the gating clauses, then bring product in for the demo so the PMs can answer any configuration questions.

We have internal legal + procurement leads available the week of Nov 1. Can you do Tue Nov 2 after 2pm PT or Wed Nov 3 morning? If you can do Wed Nov 3 at 10:00 PT, that works best for our calendar.

Also: please send the redline doc in PDF (we get formatting issues with Word sometimes). I’ve attached a brief note with our high-priority items (MSA_comments_novus_v2.docx).

Liz Barton
Director, Vendor Procurement
Novus Health
liz.barton@novushealth.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liz Barton <liz.barton@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 16:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Sync: demo logistics + MSA redline owners (compact review)

Great — thanks Liz. We can absolutely run the two-block approach. Quick notes from our side:

- We’ll lead the legal walkthrough (Ben will run the redline pass, I’ll take notes and capture outcomes).
- Demo will be tight and focused (20–30 min): we'll show retention toggles, VPC/private routing options, and a short trace of request routing so legal/procurement can see data boundaries in action.

Suggested slots (Pacific):
- Wed Nov 3 — 10:00–11:00 PT (legal 10:00–10:30; product demo 10:30–11:00)
- Thu Nov 4 — 13:00–14:00 PT (same split)

We’ll publish a 1-slide agenda and an attendee list before EOD Monday if we lock a time. Also: we can post a DocuSign preview after the call if the redlines are resolved — please confirm whether Novus prefers DocuSign or a tracked Word exchange.

Attachments: demo-runbook.xlsx (contains agenda + deck links), MSA_redlines_v3.pdf

Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liz Barton <liz.barton@novushealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 14:03:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Sync: demo logistics + MSA redline owners (compact review)

Liz / team —

Wed Nov 3 at 10:00 PT works for us. I’ll lead the redline walkthrough and will have our legal engineer on the call to answer any technical exceptions. Quick ask from our side: can Novus confirm the final redline owner(s) who will approve clause-level changes during the call? That person should have authority to mark items as resolved or to log follow-ups.

Draft agenda I’ll publish tomorrow morning:
1) 10:00–10:30 — Contract redline walk (owner: Ben Carter) — go/no-go flags on top 8 clauses
2) 10:30–11:00 — Product demo (Marissa) — retention, VPC, audit logs, fallback routing
3) Action items & next steps — agree on DocuSign cadence

We’ll also upload a DocuSign sample envelope if you want to test the preview flow ahead of signature.

Thanks — locking now on our calendar. See you Wed.

Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
